# Code of conduct

EasyCV welcomes contributors of different languages, backgrounds and experience levels. Help keep issues, pull requests and other project spaces useful and respectful.

- Discuss the work and its effects. Give concrete feedback and respect good-faith disagreement.
- Avoid harassment, discrimination, threats, personal attacks and sexualized content.
- Respect privacy. Do not post another person's contact information, account data or private messages without permission.
- Keep reports relevant to EasyCV and avoid spam or repeated disruptive posting.

Maintainers may moderate content or restrict participation that violates these expectations. For conduct concerns, contact the maintainer through the [repository's issues](https://github.com/fenghuashao/EasyCV/issues) with a minimal request for contact; avoid publishing sensitive details and wait for a suitable private channel. Security reports follow the [security policy](./SECURITY.md).
